capabilities: Render and edit a markdown note as a board, table or list
Drag cards between lists and boards
Link a list to show cards from lists on other boards
Track card dates, tags, WIP limits and change history
Convert existing boards and settings from the Kanban plugin
extras: Full user guide lives on an external documentation site; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Kanban Starlane is a fork of the Kanban plugin 2.0.51 by Matthew Meyers
problem: Obsidian's task lists are plain text with no board view, so visual kanban workflows and cross-board overviews are not possible without a plugin.
